user_story:
As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. I can add a new todo by typing in the input field with placeholder 'What needs to be done?' (selector: 'input[data-testid="text-input"]') and pressing Enter. 
2. I can complete a todo by using the toggle all checkbox (selector: 'input[data-testid="toggle-all"]'). 
3. I can delete a completed todo by clicking the 'Clear completed' button (selector: 'button.clear-completed').
